units.en: You live under an enlightened throne, wear court regalia, swim in culture and soak in the Way, and have long feasted your eyes on imperial portents.
units.literal: Now you, sir, have had the fortune to roam in an age of emperors and kings, personally to wear the cap-strings and robes of office, to float amid brilliance and steep yourself in the Way and virtue, to gaze long on the patterns of dragon and tiger—this has gone on long.

units.zh: 卒不能攄首尾，奮翼鱗，振拔洿塗，跨騰風雲，使見之者景駭，聞之者嚮震。
units.en: Yet you never spread wings from the mud or ride the tempest so that sight of you would stagger the world.
units.literal: Yet in the end you cannot spread head and tail, flap scales and fins, struggle free of the mire, leap through wind and cloud, so that those who see you stand awestruck and those who hear you turn in admiration.

units.zh: 徒樂枕經籍書，紆體衡門，上無所蔕，下無所根。
units.en: You hug your books beneath a humble gate, tethered neither to high office nor to solid ground.
units.literal: You merely delight in pillowing your head on the classics and histories, folding your limbs within a plain gate, with nothing above to cling to and nothing below to root you.

units.zh: 獨攄意虖宇宙之外，銳思於豪芒之內，潛神默記，恆以年歲。
units.en: You send the mind past the sky while polishing thoughts on a pinpoint, brooding in silence year on year.
units.literal: Alone you let your thoughts wander beyond the cosmos and hone them finer than a hair's tip; you sink your spirit in silent memorization year after year.

units.zh: 然而器不賈於當己，用不效於一世， 雖馳辯如濤波，摛藻如春華，猶無益於殿最。
units.en: Still your talent finds no buyer today, your use no proof in this life; torrents of eloquence and springtime rhetoric win you no place in the merit roll.
units.literal: Yet your vessel is not priced in the market of the moment, your use is not tested in a single generation; though your disputation surges like breakers and your phrases unfold like spring blossoms, it still does no good in the ranking of first and last.

units.zh: 意者，且運朝夕之策，定合會之計，使存有顯號，亡有美諡，不亦優虖？」
units.en: Why not scheme for office and alliance so the living gain rank and the dead fine posthumous names—would that not be wiser?"
units.literal: Perhaps you should instead ply morning-and-evening stratagems, fix plans for alliance and conference, so that the living win glorious titles and the dead fair posthumous names—would that not be better?"

units.zh: 主人逌爾而咲曰：「若賓之言，斯所謂見勢利之華，闇道德之實，守穾奧之熒燭，未卬天庭而睹白日也。
units.en: The host smiled faintly and said, "What you say is what people call seeing the blossoms of power and profit while remaining blind to the substance of the Way and virtue, guarding a flickering candle in a hidden corner without ever lifting your eyes to the heavenly court to behold the bright sun.
units.literal: The host smiled faintly and said, "If that is your doctrine, it is what people call seeing the flowers of power and profit while blind to the fruit of the Way, guarding a guttering candle in a corner and never lifting your eyes to the celestial court to behold the bright sun.

units.zh: 曩者王塗蕪穢，周失其御，侯伯方軌，戰國橫騖，於是七雄虓闞，分裂諸夏，龍戰而虎爭。
units.en: Once royal roads rotted, Zhou lost control, barons raced abreast, and the seven powers tore China in a war of dragon and tiger.
units.literal: Formerly the royal highways were choked with weeds, Zhou lost the reins, marquises ran on parallel tracks, the Warring States raced crosswise; then the seven champions roared and wrestled, split the central states, and dragon fought with tiger.

units.zh: 游說之徒，風颺電激，並起而救之，其餘猋飛景附，煜霅其間者，蓋不可勝載。
units.en: Rhetoricians stormed in like wind and lightning, and hangers-on swarmed beyond counting.
units.literal: Wandering persuaders, swift as wind and lightning, rose together to rescue the age; the rest, like gales and flying shadows attaching themselves, flashed among them in numbers no carriage could carry.

units.zh: 當此之時，搦朽摩鈍，鈆刀皆能壹斷，是故魯連飛一矢而蹶千金，虞卿以顧眄而捐相印也。
units.en: In that chaos a blunt knife could decide a fate, so Lu Zhonglian felled a fortune with one shaft and Yu Qing dropped a premier's seal at a glance.
units.literal: In such a time, even a rotten twig or a dull blade could cut clean at one stroke; therefore Lu Zhonglian loosed a single arrow and toppled a thousand pounds of gold, and Yu Qing, with a glance, cast away the minister's seal.

units.zh: 夫啾發投曲，感耳之聲，合之律度，淫䵷而不可聽者，非韶、夏之樂也；
units.en: Shrill novelty may please the ear yet fail the scale—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;
units.literal: For twittering runs and tossed-off tunes that please the ear yet, set beside pitch and measure, prove lewd and unfit to hear—that is not the music of Shao and Xia;

units.zh: 因勢合變，偶時之會，風移俗易，乖忤而不可通者，非君子之法也。
units.en: and tactics that chase fashion until custom warps are not the gentleman's law.
units.literal: for opportunism that rides the moment, suits passing fashion, shifts custom, and ends in perverse blockage—that is not the gentleman's law.

units.zh: 及至從人合之，衡人散之，亡命漂說，羇旅騁辭，商鞅挾三術以鑽孝公，李斯奮時務而要始皇，彼皆躡風雲之會，履顛沛之勢，據徼乘邪以求一日之富貴，朝為榮華，夕而焦瘁，福不盈眥，禍益於世，凶人且以自悔，況吉士而是賴虖！
units.en: Think of the vertical and horizontal strategists and the exiles who peddled their arguments: Shang Yang used three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, and Li Si exploited the needs of the age to win over the First Emperor. They caught the winds of opportunity and rode the turmoil of their times, seizing crooked chances to gain a day's wealth and honor. Glorious in the morning, by evening they were ruined; their good fortune did not last a moment, while their calamities burdened the age. Even evil men came to regret this path. How much less should a good man rely on it?
units.literal: When the vertical persuaders united men and the horizontal persuaders divided them, fugitives wandered about arguing and travelers displayed their rhetoric. Shang Yang carried three techniques to insinuate himself with Duke Xiao, while Li Si exerted himself in the urgent affairs of the age and won over the First Emperor. They all stepped into a conjunction of wind and cloud, trod a situation of upheaval, relied on narrow chances, and rode crooked paths in pursuit of a day's wealth and honor. In the morning they flourished; by evening they were withered. Their good fortune did not last the blink of an eye, while their calamities burdened the age. Even wicked men came to regret this; how much less should a good man rely on it!

units.zh: 且功不可以虛成，名不可以偽立，韓設辯以徼君，呂行詐以賈國。
units.en: Merit cannot be faked nor name bought: Han Fei angled his prince with rhetoric, Lü Buwei sold the realm by deceit.
units.literal: Moreover merit cannot be hollowly achieved, nor name falsely erected: Han Fei set sophistry to hook his ruler, Lü Buwei practiced fraud to traffic in the state.

units.zh: 說難既酋，其身乃囚；
units.en: Han Fei completed "The Difficulty of Persuasion," only to be imprisoned;
units.literal: When the "Difficulty of Persuasion" was finished, his person was imprisoned;

units.zh: 秦貨既貴，厥宗亦隧。
units.en: once Lü Buwei's Qin merchandise had fetched its high price, his clan too sank into the grave.
units.literal: when Qin's bribe had grown costly, his clan too went down the tunnel.

units.zh: 是故仲尼抗浮雲之志，孟軻養浩然之氣，彼豈樂為迂闊哉？
units.en: So Confucius fixed his mind above the clouds and Mencius fed the flood-like breath—were they merely eccentric?
units.literal: Therefore Zhongni set his will above drifting clouds, and Meng Ke nurtured the flood-like qi—did they delight in being impractical?

units.zh: 道不可以貳也。
units.en: The Way allows no divided loyalty.
units.literal: The Way does not admit doubleness.

units.zh: 方今大漢洒埽群穢，夷險芟荒，廓帝紘，恢皇綱，基隆於羲、農，規廣於黃、唐；
units.en: Great Han has cleansed the mire, cut the brambles, stretched the emperor's net wider than Fu Xi or Shen Nong, vaster than Huangdi or Yao;
units.literal: Now the great Han has swept away every stain, leveled peril, mowed the wilds, spread the imperial cord, widened the royal net; its foundation rises higher than Xi and Nong, its compass vaster than Huang and Tang;

units.zh: 其君天下也，炎之如日，威之如神，函之如海，養之如春。
units.en: its rule warms like the sun, awes like a god, holds all like the sea, and quickens like spring.
units.literal: in ruling all under Heaven it blazes like the sun, awes like a spirit, embraces like the sea, nurtures like spring.

units.zh: 是以六合之內，莫不同原共流，沐浴玄德，稟卬太和，枝附葉著，譬猶屮木之殖山林，鳥魚之毓川澤，得氣者蕃滋，失時者苓落，參天墬而施化，豈云人事之厚薄哉？
units.en: Within the six directions all drink one stream, bathe in hidden virtue, and cling like leaves to a tree; timing makes the growth, heaven and earth do the shaping—human whim weighs little.
units.literal: Therefore within the six coordinates none fail to share one source and one current, bathe in dark virtue, drink deep of supreme harmony, cling like branches and leaves; they are like plants growing in mountain forests, birds and fish breeding in rivers and marshes—those who catch the vapor flourish and multiply, those who miss the season wither and fall; Heaven and earth join to spread transformation—how can one speak of human affairs being thick or thin?

units.zh: 今子處皇世而論戰國，耀所聞而疑所覿，欲從旄敦而度高虖泰山，懷氿濫而測深虖重淵，亦未至也。」
units.en: Now you, sir, live in a glorious age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzled by hearsay while doubting what you see. You would use a low mound to gauge Mount Tai and a puddle to fathom the abyss. You are nowhere near the mark."
units.literal: Now you, sir, stand in a brilliant age yet discourse on the Warring States, dazzle yourself with hearsay and doubt what your eyes see; you would measure Mount Tai with a yardstick from Dunhuang or fathom the abyss with a puddle from a marsh—you have not reached the mark."

units.zh: 賓曰：「若夫鞅、斯之倫，衰周之凶人，既聞命矣。
units.en: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.
units.literal: The guest said, "As for men like Shang Yang and Li Si, villains of failing Zhou—I have heard your command.

units.zh: 敢問上古之士，處身行道，輔世成名，可述於後者，默而已虖？」
units.en: But did the ancients who kept the Way, aided their times, and left great names do it in silence?"
units.literal: May I ask: among men of high antiquity who kept their persons, practiced the Way, aided the age, and won names handed down—did they stay silent?"

units.zh: 主人曰：「何為其然也！
units.en: The host answered, "Why imagine such a thing?
units.literal: The host said, "Why should it be so?

units.zh: 昔咎繇謨虞，箕子訪周，言通帝王，謀合聖神；
units.en: Gao Yao advised Shun, Jizi counseled Zhou—their speech reached kings, their plans matched the spirits;
units.literal: Formerly Gao Yao counseled Shun, Jizi was questioned in Zhou—their words penetrated emperors and kings, their plans matched sages and spirits;

units.zh: 殷說夢發於傅巖，周望兆動於渭濱，齊甯激聲於康衢，漢良受書於邳沂，皆俟命而神交，匪詞言之所信，故能建必然之策，展無窮之勳也。
units.en: Fu Yue was revealed in a dream at Fuyan; Lü Wang's omen stirred on the banks of the Wei; Ning Qi's song rang out at the crossroads; and Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and communed in spirit, relying on more than words; thus they could devise certain strategies and achieve immeasurable merit.
units.literal: The dream of Yin's Fu Yue arose at Fuyan; the omen of Zhou's Lü Wang stirred on the bank of the Wei; Qi's Ning Qi raised his voice at the broad crossroads; and Han's Zhang Liang received the book at the bridge at Xiapi. All awaited their appointed time and met in spirit, not through trust in spoken words; therefore they could establish certain strategies and unfold inexhaustible merit.

units.zh: 近者陸子優繇，新語以興；
units.en: Lu Jia, calm and unhurried, raised the New Discourses;
units.literal: In recent times Master Lu, leisurely and easy, raised the New Discourses to prominence;

units.zh: 董生下帷，發藻儒林；
units.en: Dong Zhongshu drew his curtain and lit the grove of scholars;
units.literal: Dong Zhongshu let down his curtain and sent brilliance through the Confucian grove;

units.zh: 劉向司籍，辯章舊聞；
units.en: Liu Xiang ordered the archives and clarified antiquity;
units.literal: Liu Xiang superintended the registers and sorted the old hearsay;

units.zh: 揚雄覃思，法言、大玄：皆及時君之門闈，究先聖之壼奧，婆娑虖術藝之場，休息虖篇籍之囿，以全其質而發其文，用納虖聖聽，列炳於後人，斯非其亞與！
units.en: Yang Xiong brooded out the Model Sayings and Great Arcana; each entered the ruler's gate, sounded the sages' chambers, ranged the field of learning, and left texts that shine for posterity—second only to the greatest.
units.literal: Yang Xiong pondered deeply and produced the Model Sayings and the Great Mystery: all reached the inner gates of the timely ruler, fathomed the inner rooms of former sages, wandered in the arena of arts, rested in the park of writings, thereby preserving their substance and releasing their pattern, were taken into the sage's hearing, and blaze in rows for later men—are these not next after the highest?

units.zh: 若乃夷抗行於首陽，惠降志於辱仕，顏耽樂於簞瓢，孔終篇於西狩，聲盈塞於天淵，真吾徒之師表也。
units.en: Then there were Boyi, who upheld his conduct on Mount Shouyang; Liuxia Hui, who humbled his aspirations to take a dishonorable post; Yan Hui, who delighted in his basket of rice and gourd of water; and Confucius, who brought his classic to an end with the hunt in the west. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are truly exemplars for men such as us.
units.literal: Or again, Boyi upheld his conduct on Shouyang; Liuxia Hui lowered his aspirations to accept a humiliating post; Yan Hui delighted in a basket of rice and a gourd of water; and Confucius ended his classic with the western hunt. Their fame fills the space between heaven and the abyss; they are true models for men such as us.

units.zh: 且吾聞之：壹陰壹陽，天墬之方；
units.en: I have heard that yin and yang are the square of heaven and earth;
units.literal: Moreover I have heard: one yin, one yang—this is Heaven and earth's square;

units.zh: 乃文乃質，王道之綱；
units.en: culture and substance are the twin cords of the kingly Way;
units.literal: both pattern and substance—this is the kingly Way's cord;

units.zh: 有同有異，聖喆之常。
units.en: sameness and difference are the sage's constant scales.
units.literal: having sameness and having difference—this is the constant of the wise and good.

units.zh: 故曰：慎修所志，守爾天符，委命共己，味道之腴，神之聽之，名其舍諸！
units.en: The ode says: polish your purpose, keep Heaven's tally, yield life to what is already yours, taste the Way's fat—when spirits listen, can fame stay away?
units.literal: Therefore it is said: carefully cultivate what you aim at, guard your Heaven-given tally, entrust life to what is already in yourself, taste the richness of the Way; when the spirits listen, will fame leave you?

units.zh: 賓又不聞龢氏之璧韞於荊石，隨侯之珠藏於蜯蛤虖？
units.en: Have you never heard how the He-bi jade slept inside a dull rock or Sui's pearl hid in a shell?
units.literal: Again, have you not heard that the He clan jade was wrapped in a Jing stone, or that the Marquis of Sui's pearl lay hidden in a mussel?

units.zh: 歷世莫眡，不知其將含景耀，吐英精，曠千載而流夜光也。
units.en: Ages passed before anyone knew they would blaze with inner fire and gleam in the dark after a thousand years.
units.literal: Age after age none saw them, not knowing they would hold radiant light and spit essence, idle a thousand years yet shed light by night.

units.zh: 應龍潛於潢汙，魚黿媟之，不睹其能奮靈德，合風雲，超忽荒，而躆顥蒼也。
units.en: The winged dragon wallowed in a puddle while minnows mocked him, blind to the day he would ride the storm into the blue.
units.literal: The responding dragon lurked in a muddy pool; fish and turtles despised him, not seeing how he could rouse numinous virtue, join wind and cloud, leap beyond the vast waste, and stand in the azure sky.

units.zh: 故夫泥蟠而天飛者，應龍之神也；
units.en: Mud-bound yet sky-soaring—that is the responding dragon;
units.literal: Therefore one who coils in the mud yet flies to Heaven is the spirit of the responding dragon;

units.zh: 先賤而後貴者，龢、隨之珍也；
units.en: cheap at first, costly later—that is the He jade and Sui pearl;
units.literal: one who is base first and honored later is the treasure of He and Sui;

units.zh: 時闇而久章者，君子之真也。
units.en: long hidden, long bright—that is the gentleman's truth.
units.literal: one who is dim for a time yet shines long is the truth of the gentleman.

units.zh: 若乃牙、曠清耳於管絃，離婁眇目於豪分；
units.en: When Ya and Kuang tune their ears to music, or Li Lou splits a hair's breadth;
units.literal: If then Ya and Kuang clear their ears to strings and pipes, and Li Lou strains his eyes to a hair's fraction;

units.zh: 逢蒙絕技於弧矢，班輸榷巧於斧斤；
units.en: when Peng Meng masters the bow or Lu Ban the adze;
units.literal: Peng Meng exhausts his skill on bow and arrow, Lu Ban measures his craft on axe and adze;

units.zh: 良樂軼能於相馭，烏獲抗力於千鈞；
units.en: when Wang Liang and Bo Le judge horses or Wu Huo hefts a thousand jun;
units.literal: Wang Liang and Bo Le surpass others in judging and driving, Wu Huo matches strength against a thousand jun;

units.zh: 龢、鵲發精於鍼石，研、桑心計於無垠。
units.en: Yi He and Bian Que mastered the needle and stone probe; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang's financial calculations knew no bounds.
units.literal: Yi He and Bian Que brought their finest skill to needles and stone probes; Ji Yan and Sang Hongyang applied mental calculation without limit.

units.zh: 僕亦不任廁技於彼列，故密爾自娛於斯文。」
units.en: I am not fit to stack my small talent beside theirs, so I take quiet joy in these words alone."
units.literal: I, your servant, am not fit to crowd my petty skill among them; therefore I quietly take my pleasure in this writing."

units.zh: 之才卽應聲云：「為是宋鵲，為是韓盧，為逐李斯東走，為負帝女南徂。」
units.en: The others asked him to name them on sight. Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"
units.literal: The others tried to have him name them on sight; Zhicai answered at once, "Are they Song Que, or Han Lu—or chasing Li Si eastward, or carrying the Emperor's Daughter south?"

units.zh: 雄桀之士因勢輔時，作為權詐以相傾覆，吳有孫武，齊有孫臏，魏有吳起，秦有商鞅，皆禽敵立勝，垂著篇籍。
units.en: Strategists such as Sun Wu, Sun Bin, Wu Qi, and Shang Yang turned military thought toward power and deception, with influential textual legacies.
units.literal: Heroic and ruthless men, taking advantage of the age, made power techniques and deception to overturn one another: Wu had Sun Wu, Qi had Sun Bin, Wei had Wu Qi, Qin had Shang Yang-all captured enemies and secured victories, leaving written works.

units.zh: 陵夷至於戰國，韓任申子，秦用商鞅，連相坐之法，造參夷之誅；
units.en: By Warring States times, collective-liability and extreme punitive innovations became standard in some states.
units.literal: Declining down to the Warring States, Han employed Shenzi, Qin used Shang Yang: laws of mutual implication and punishments of annihilating collateral lines were created;

units.zh: 孫、吳、商、白之徒，皆身誅戮於前，而功滅亡於後。
units.en: The lineages of Sunzi, Wuzi, Shang Yang, and Bai Qi ended in violent ruin, and their victories did not endure.
units.literal: Followers of Sun, Wu, Shang, and Bai were all themselves executed in front, and their achievements perished afterward.

units.zh: 成王不疑周公，孝昭委任霍光，各因其時以成名，大矣哉！
units.en: King Cheng did not doubt the Duke of Zhou; Emperor Zhao entrusted Huo Guang with power. Each, in his own time, achieved renown thereby. How great this was!
units.literal: King Cheng did not doubt the Duke of Zhou; Emperor Zhao the Filial entrusted power to Huo Guang—each in his time achieved renown thereby. How great!

units.zh: 如田子方、段干木、吳起、禽滑釐之屬，皆受業於子夏之倫，為王者師。
units.en: Figures like Tian Zifang, Duan Ganmu, Wu Qi, and Qin Guli all studied under the circle of Zixia and went on to become teachers of kings.
units.literal: Men such as Tian Zifang, Duan Ganmu, Wu Qi, and Qin Guli all studied under the circle of Zixia and became teachers of kings.

units.zh: 是時獨魏文侯好學。
units.en: At that time, only Marquis Wen of Wei was devoted to learning.
units.literal: At that time, only Marquis Wen of Wei was fond of learning.

units.zh: 削木剪紙，皆無故事，班、墨之思，何以相過。」
units.en: Carving wood and cutting paper has no precedent—how could Ban and Mo's inventiveness be surpassed?"
units.literal: Carving wood and cutting paper—there is no precedent for that; how could the thought of Ban and Mo be surpassed?"

units.zh: 哀帝即位，師丹輔政，建言：「古之聖王莫不設井田，然後治乃可平。
units.en: When Emperor Ai took the throne, Shi Dan assisted in governance and proposed: "The sage kings of antiquity all established well-field systems; only then could government be made even.
units.literal: When Emperor Ai took the throne, Shi Dan assisted in governance and proposed: "The sage kings of antiquity all established well-field systems; only then could rule be made even.

units.zh: 孝文皇帝承亡周亂秦兵革之後，天下空虛，故務勸農桑，帥以節儉。
units.en: Emperor Wen inherited the ruin left by the fall of Zhou and Qin's wars; the realm was empty, so he urged farming and sericulture and led by austerity.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowen inherited the era after the fall of Zhou and Qin's disorder and warfare; the realm was empty, so he devoted himself to encouraging farming and sericulture and led by frugality.

units.zh: 民始充實，未有并兼之害，故不為民田及奴婢為限。
units.en: The people first became sufficient; annexation had not yet become a problem, so no limits were set on commoners' fields or on slaves and maidservants.
units.literal: The people first grew sufficient; there was as yet no harm of annexation, so he did not set limits on common people's fields or on slaves and maidservants.

units.zh: 今累世承平，豪富吏民訾數鉅萬，而貧弱俞困。
units.en: Now, after generations of peace, powerful officials and wealthy commoners amass fortunes of tens of thousands, while the poor and weak grow ever more distressed.
units.literal: Now, after generations of peace, powerful and wealthy officials and commoners accumulate tens of thousands in assets, while the poor and weak grow ever more distressed.

units.zh: 蓋君子為政，貴因循而重改作，然所以有改者，將以救急也。
units.en: In governance a gentleman values continuity and is wary of reform, yet reform exists precisely to meet emergencies.
units.literal: Generally in governance the gentleman values continuity and is wary of renovation; yet renovation exists to rescue emergencies.

units.zh: 亦未可詳，宜略為限。」
units.en: The details cannot yet be fixed; limits should be set only in outline."
units.literal: It also cannot yet be made detailed; limits should be set in outline."
